component.name: TaskMan
component.summary: Native task manager and system monitor

description.p: TaskMan is a fast, native task manager: processes with their CPU, memory, disk, network and GPU activity, per-core performance graphs, services, startup entries and detailed per-process evidence, rendered by its own CPU renderer or by the GPU.

On Linux the application runs as an ordinary user. Privileged actions (ending another user's process, changing its priority, controlling a service) and the kernel evidence an unelevated process cannot read are served by the optional TaskMan core service, a systemd unit that accepts a fixed allowlist of requests over a local socket from the user the package was installed for.

ul.li: Process list with apps, background processes and hierarchy
Performance history for CPU, memory, disks, network and GPUs
Hardware sensors: temperatures, fans, voltages, power draw
No telemetry and no network access

description.p: Per-file read and written bytes on Windows, a Linux core service with elevated process evidence and actions, and a large pass of Linux probes that now report "unavailable" instead of a measurement nobody made.
